evals.prompt: In an isolated fake Claude/iCloud workspace, verify that all expected file and directory symlinks are healthy and that Claude Desktop metadata has no orphaned transcript references.
evals.expected_output: The Doctor reports all manifest entries OK and desktop orphan count 0 without modifying real user files.
expectations: All manifest entries are classified as OK.
Desktop orphan count is 0 using the fake workspace, not the real home directory.
The command emits machine-readable JSON suitable for automation.

evals.prompt: In an isolated fake workspace, simulate atomic replace turning a managed symlink into a newer regular local file, then repair it.
evals.expected_output: The Doctor copies the newer local file to the cloud target, backs up both sides as needed, restores the symlink, and a follow-up check returns OK.
expectations: The cloud target receives the newer local content.
The local path is restored as a symlink to the cloud target.
A backup directory is created before destructive relinking.
A follow-up check returns OK for the entry.

evals.prompt: In an isolated fake workspace, simulate the same atomic replace break while Claude is running and run safe repair.
evals.expected_output: The Doctor preserves data by copying local content to cloud, but defers deleting/relinking the local file while Claude is running.
expectations: The cloud target is updated with local content.
The local path remains a regular file rather than being relinked.
The report explicitly says relink was deferred because Claude is running.

evals.prompt: In an isolated fake workspace, simulate local and cloud having divergent file contents with no reliable ledger and nearly identical mtimes.
evals.expected_output: The Doctor refuses to pick a winner, leaves both files untouched, and reports a conflict.
expectations: The cloud file content is unchanged.
The local file content is unchanged.
No symlink is created.
The report contains a conflict/no automatic overwrite action.

evals.prompt: In an isolated fake workspace, simulate a directory symlink pointing to the wrong target and repair it.
evals.expected_output: The Doctor identifies WRONG_SYMLINK_TARGET and replaces the symlink with the expected cloud target.
expectations: The pre-repair status is WRONG_SYMLINK_TARGET.
The local path is a symlink after repair.
The symlink target equals the expected cloud directory.
A follow-up check returns OK.

evals.prompt: In an isolated fake workspace, compare a real local directory and a real cloud directory with only-local, only-cloud, and changed files.
evals.expected_output: Deep-check reports the tree drift counts and representative samples without modifying either directory.
expectations: Deep-check reports one only-local file.
Deep-check reports one only-cloud file.
Deep-check reports one changed file.
Neither directory is modified.

evals.prompt: In an isolated fake workspace, create Claude Desktop metadata pointing to a missing transcript, then add the transcript.
evals.expected_output: The first check reports one orphan, and the second check reports zero orphans after the transcript is added.
expectations: The orphan check uses fake manifest paths.
Missing transcript yields orphan count 1.
Adding the matching JSONL transcript yields orphan count 0.

evals.prompt: Generate the Doctor LaunchAgent plist in dry-run mode.
evals.expected_output: The plist is syntactically valid and runs repair --safe --apply --update-state --quiet every 300 seconds.
expectations: The generated plist is valid.
ProgramArguments include repair --safe --apply --update-state --quiet.
StartInterval is 300.
Dry-run does not write to the real LaunchAgents directory.

evals.prompt: In an isolated fake workspace, run the handoff flow with --yes --force after atomic replace turns a managed symlink into a regular local file.
evals.expected_output: The Doctor performs the repair, restores the symlink, updates the cloud copy, runs a final check, and prints HANDOFF_READY.
expectations: The local file is restored as a symlink to the cloud target.
The cloud target contains the newer local content.
The final report prints HANDOFF_READY.
The final report shows desktop orphan count 0.

evals.prompt: In an isolated fake workspace, create Claude Desktop metadata under a foreign owner group with a valid matching Claude Code transcript, while the current owner group does not contain that metadata.
evals.expected_output: desktop-check reports one visible missing metadata record, and desktop-repair --apply copies it into the current owner group. A follow-up desktop-check reports zero visible missing records.
expectations: The current ownerAccountId is read from cowork-enabled-cli-ops.json.
The repair copies only local_*.json metadata, not Local Storage or LevelDB.
The copied metadata still points at the original cliSessionId.
The repair is idempotent when run again.

evals.prompt: In an isolated fake workspace, create foreign Claude Desktop metadata whose cliSessionId has no matching transcript.
evals.expected_output: desktop-repair --apply reports the record as an orphan and does not copy it into the current owner group.
expectations: Missing transcript yields desktop visibility orphan count 1.
No target metadata file is created for the orphan.
The orphan remains visible in the report for manual investigation.

evals.prompt: Run regular check --json in an isolated fake workspace with foreign-but-valid Desktop metadata missing from the current owner group.
evals.expected_output: The JSON response includes desktopVisibility with missingVisibleCount 1 in addition to existing desktopOrphans information.
expectations: check --json includes desktopVisibility.
missingVisibleCount reflects owner-group UI visibility, not transcript existence.
desktopOrphans remains zero when the transcript exists.
